_about: Fault Macro mode tuning. Dev builds of the plug-in reload this file when it's saved; fault-render reads it too. Each key's meaning is in _notes.

_notes.bendZoneStart: Bend: knob position (0-1) where each of the 7 zones begins. Zones: off, reverse, octave, two octaves, slew, tape stop, everything.
_notes.bendChanceLow: Bend: chance per tick that something happens, at the start of each zone.
_notes.bendChanceHigh: Bend: the same chance at the end of each zone (linear between).
_notes.bendWeights: Bend: one row per zone, the weights for picking reverse, octave, two octaves, slew, tape stop when something happens.
_notes.bendAlsoReverse: Bend: per zone, the chance a pitch, slew or stop event also plays reversed.
_notes.bendUpChance: Bend: octave jumps go up with this chance, otherwise down.
_notes.slewRangeOctaves: Bend slew: the target speed is random within plus or minus this many octaves.
_notes.slewTimeMin: Bend slew: shortest glide time constant, as a fraction of the tick period.
_notes.slewTimeMax: Bend slew: longest glide time constant, as a fraction of the tick period.
_notes.tapeStopMin: Bend tape stop: shortest time to reach a standstill, as a fraction of the tick period.
_notes.tapeStopMax: Bend tape stop: longest time to reach a standstill, as a fraction of the tick period.
_notes.tapeStopCurve: Bend tape stop: speed follows (1 - t)^curve. Above 1 brakes hard at first, below 1 holds speed and stops late.
_notes.clickLevel: Bend everything zone: level of the vinyl click on a hard direction change (0 = none).
_notes.clickMs: Bend everything zone: click length in milliseconds.
_notes.bendRateRefSeconds: Bend: ticks faster than this many seconds get fewer events...
_notes.bendRateExponent: ...the chance is multiplied by (period / ref) to this power (0 = no scaling).
_notes.breakZoneStart: Break: knob position where each of the 7 zones begins. Zones: off, halve, jump, subdivide, audio rate, silence, everything.
_notes.breakChanceLow: Break: chance per tick that something happens, at the start of each zone.
_notes.breakChanceHigh: Break: the same chance at the end of each zone.
_notes.breakWeights: Break: one row per zone, the weights for halve, jump, subdivide, audio rate, silence. Options that can't work at the current Time / Repeats are skipped.
_notes.breakSecondHalf: Break halve: chance of looping the second half of the slice rather than the first.
_notes.breakDivisors: Break subdivide: how many pieces a slice can be cut into (extra repeats on top of the Repeats knob).
_notes.breakDivWeightsFree: Break subdivide: weight of each divisor on the internal clock.
_notes.breakDivWeightsSync: Break subdivide: weight of each divisor on the host or note clock.
_notes.breakSubOffStart: Break subdivide and audio rate: chance the looped piece is a random one rather than the slice's first (a ratchet on the transient).
_notes.breakMinSliceMs: Break: halve and subdivide never make a slice shorter than this (ms).
_notes.audioRateHzMin: Break audio rate: lowest slice repetition rate (Hz).
_notes.audioRateHzMax: Break audio rate: highest slice repetition rate (Hz).
_notes.silenceMin: Break silence: smallest fraction of each repeat that goes silent.
_notes.silenceMax: Break silence: largest fraction (the brief caps it at 0.9).
_notes.breakStack: Break: per zone, the chance each other kind of option (cut, jump, silence) stacks on top of the one picked.
_notes.breakRateRefSeconds: Break: ticks faster than this many seconds get fewer events...
_notes.breakRateExponent: ...the chance is multiplied by (period / ref) to this power.
